"},{"attributes":{"italic":true},"insert":"Onions, have layers. "},{"insert":"

Consultation Sisay is an attempt at a layered combo deck using the commander Sisay, Captain of the Weatherlight. The deck was created with the intent of trying to make a deck that could take a commander like Sisay and bring her to a game with some of the biggest baddies in the format. 

The deck takes pieces of a few archetypes and tries to combine them into one solid gameplan which can ebb and flow with the game, while also being fast and consistent. 

The Archetypes/Packages the deck pulls from are:

Consultation "},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
I have found consultation lines to be extremely lean and resilient as I have become more and more comfortable with the lines in other decks I've played. Here, the Consultation Lines work well with our Hulk Piles as well as our commander. Sisay is able to tutor out a Jace from the commander zone, while our Hulk Piles include "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Laboratory Maniac"}},{"insert":"  and "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Spellseeker"}},{"insert":" which allows us to win on the spot with a cantrip and some protection of course. 

Sisay Tutoring Jace Line: 

Have Sisay be a 5/5 (This means there are 3 colors amongst non-Sisay Legendary Permanents you control)
Activate Sisay
Get "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Jace, Wielder of Mysteries"}},{"insert":" 
Activate Jace
Cast "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Demonic Consultation"}},{"insert":" or "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Tainted Pact"}},{"insert":" 
Jace ability resolves
Win!

Opus Thief"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Opus Thief is an extremely powerful series of synergies and effects which allow us to break parity on cards like "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Timetwister"}},{"insert":", "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Wheel of Fortune"}},{"insert":", and "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Windfall"}},{"insert":". Our payoffs are often efficient and useful throughout the game, while "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Narset, Parter of Veils"}},{"insert":" can be tutored off of Sisay at instant with the right board state. Additionally, I felt that the Opus Thief archetype would be important and useful is the lack of inherent card advantage our commander has to offer. Adding lots of wheels and hate bears/stax effects on card draw would help us keep up with the Tymna and Thrasios players in the midpoint of the game is my hope. 

Flash-Hulk"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
I already mentioned one of our Hulk lines, but will cover why I think playing Flash Hulk is worth it in this deck. First of all, decks with high threat density are really fun to play and force the table into interesting scenarios much of the time. Additionally, Flash Hulk can sometimes give you really aggressive starts and free wins if the table isn't appropriately prepared for it. I think testing the table is important and I felt dedicating a few slots to the combo was worth the cost of entry to an extremely powerful line.  

Hulk lines: 

"},{"insert":{"card-link":"Spellseeker"}},{"insert":" and "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Laboratory Maniac"}},{"insert":"
Get "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Demonic Consultation"}},{"insert":" or"},{"insert":{"card-link":"Tainted Pact"}},{"insert":".
Cast either. 
Draw a card. Win the game. 

-----

"},{"insert":{"card-link":"Vigean Graftmage"}},{"insert":", "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Torch Courier"}},{"insert":", and "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Incubation Druid"}},{"insert":" 
VG puts a counter on Incubation Druid
Crack Torch Courrier to give Incubation Druid haste
Incubation Druid creates UUU
Untap and repeat infinitely until you have infinite mana of every color
Play your commander.
Activate your commander
Get an "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Okina, Temple to the Grandfathers"}},{"insert":" into play. 
Use Okina to pump up Sisay.
Activate again, get "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Thrasios, Triton Hero"}},{"insert":" in play
Draw your whole deck. 
Win with lab maniac, Jace, or time twister loop. 

----

There is also a very similar line to the one above that will not create infinite mana of every color but will get pretty close. 

Vigean Graftmage, Deathrite Shaman/Torch Courier, "},{"insert":{"card-link":"Bloom Tender"}},{"insert":"
Bloom tender will tap for UGR or UGB depending on what you tutor for. 

If you crack the torch courier to give bloom tender haste, it will not make infinite mana of every color unless you have other colors on the battlefield. Additionally, you will not be able to create infinite blue mana. You will need at least 2 additional blue mana to put Thrasios into play. Casting Sisay will give you access to white and already having a black or red permanent will help you go off with this line. 

The deck isn't intended to go off this way, it just happens to come up sometimes. 

Send off"},{"attributes":{"header":2},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
This deck isn't trying to be tier 1, its just trying to win its share of games when your friends come to play with their fancy toys. If you have any comments or questions about the list you can usually find me on discord as Braden#9000. 

Special thanks to /u/ShaperSavant and ScottyKnows for helping me through the construction of the deck and pointing me in the right direction. 

Thanks to my friend Mike who inspired me to test out this weird commander.
